conversation.text: Hi! We're staying in Seminyak for a week with our two kids. How much for a chef to cook dinner at our villa one night?
Lovely — Seminyak is right in our core area. For a private dinner our Romantic/Family dinners start from IDR 2,200,000++ per person. Would this be just the two of you or the kids too?
All four of us. That sounds like a lot though?
It's premium, multi-course, Michelin-trained. The '++' is +10% service +11% tax.
Can we just talk to the chef directly to sort the menu?
All communication goes through our office team to keep quality consistent; we coordinate with the chef once it's confirmed.

notes: Lost on price + no close. Should have offered a kid-friendly option, a group total, and held a date.
